title: Assertion: Request-Grant-Done Protocol
constraints: A transaction starts with a one-cycle `req`. `gnt` must follow 1 … 3 cycles later, then `done` 1 … 5 cycles after the grant.
No new `req` may start while a transaction is open (from `req` up to and including its `done` cycle).
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: The textbook form is one sequence: `req |-> ##[1:3] gnt ##[1:5] done`. Verilator does not report failures of chained range delays, so check the two windows separately: `req |-> ##[1:3] gnt` and `gnt |-> ##[1:5] done`.
For the no-overlap rule, keep a `busy` flag: set by `req`, cleared by `done`, and assert `req |-> !busy`.
Update `busy` with nonblocking assignments so the assertion sees the value from before the edge.

examples.title: ok
examples.input: req, gnt 2 cycles later, done 3 cycles after gnt
